title: lait.deps.yml
description: lait's dependency manifest: GitHub-hosted workflow/agent/skill files fetched by `lait deps`. See docs/usage/ja/deps.md.

deps.description: Dependency name -> requirement. The name is the registry key the materialized file is reachable under (`lait run <name>`, `lait agent run <name>`, `skills: [name]`).

source.description: github:OWNER/REPO/PATH (the canonical form `lait deps add` writes), or any spelling `deps add` accepts.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit to fetch `source` at. Absent tracks the repository's default branch, re-resolved on `deps update`.

kind.description: Which registry the file joins. Inferred from the source path's extension when absent (.yml/.yaml = workflow, .md = agent, SKILL.md = skill).
